title: Chapter 181 Zhao Tianze Is In A Dilemma
content:
Chapter 181 Zhao Tianze Is In A Dilemma

If he doesn't attack, he can only be beaten passively. If he takes the initiative to attack, Wang Shuo will get what he wants.

Unless absolutely necessary, Wang Shuo would not rush directly into the opponent's territory.

After all, he has fewer troops than his opponent. Although his soldiers are high-level and strong, it is still disadvantageous for him to engage in street fighting and close combat.

An hour later, Zhao Tianze fell into an extremely entangled situation.

Is he starting to doubt his life?

Did the other party have an ambush?

"Lord, no matter whether the other party has an ambush or not, we can't sit still and wait for death!" A shield soldier commander said sincerely, with an anxious look on his face.

Of course, Zhao Tianze also knew that it would definitely not work to be passively beaten, but he was worried about the gains and losses when taking the initiative.

For a moment, I was anxious, like an ant on a hot pot.

Another general who was loyal to him also said with a serious face: "Lord, attack, it's nothing to be beaten passively. Even if there is an ambush on the opposite side, we have the advantage of troops, and we still have a great chance of winning. Take the initiative to attack!" "

Zhao Tianze, who calmed down, also felt that what this person said made sense.

"Okay, then we will use our strong strength to crush them all. No matter what their plots and tricks are, they are all paper tigers in the face of absolute strength."

"Let's go and crush the bastards on the other side!" Zhao Tianze pulled out his sword and shouted at the soldiers below.

"war!"

"war!"

…

Wang Shuo stood next to the catapult and shook his head when he heard the feeble shouts from the other side.

It seems that the other party is finally willing to face him head-on.

"I've been waiting for a long time. Hide the bronze ballista and wait until they get within the attack range to reveal it."

"Yes, Lord Lord."

Li Jianguo asked the soldiers to stand in front of the ballista to block the view of the other side.

Soon, the soldiers from Fengze Village couldn't hold it any longer and rushed out.

In the distance, Ayub, who was observing the enemy's situation with a telescope, had a smile on his face.

"Mount your horse and prepare to rush into the enemy's square formation from the flank." After giving the order, the Golden Fire Cavalry rushed directly out of the woods.

Since the cavalry needs a certain distance to provide a strong impact, it takes at least 2 minutes to reach the battlefield, so it is not too early to be exposed.

It can be said to be just right.

Close.

The ones at the forefront were the shield troops.

Everyone held a wooden shield in their hands, and only a few people had iron shields in their hands.

At this time, the effectiveness of the catapults had been greatly reduced. Li Jianguo directly asked all the soldiers of the ballista battalion to operate bronze ballistas to speed up the loading of spears.

Strive to be able to fire one more round of attacks during hand-to-hand combat.

Wait until the vanguard of Fengze Village reaches the attack range of the ballista.

All the Black Mountain bandits dispersed to both sides, revealing 10 large killer vehicles that exuded bronze luster.

The shield soldiers on the opposite side were obviously stunned. Even if they had no experience, they knew that the spears on them were the life-killing talismans that were meant to be shot at them.

The shield soldiers in the front row immediately slowed down, but were pushed forward by the impact of the soldiers behind them.

A few soldiers were even pushed down.

Soon they will have the brothers to thank for pushing them down.

A row of black iron spears roared in with the sound of breaking through the air, directly stringing the standing soldiers into "candied haws".

The soldier who fell on the ground looked up and saw that his soul was filled with death.

Fortunately for them, there was a firing interval for the bronze ballista.

For the soldiers in Fengze Village, this can be said to be great news.
